##### Project general facts

Knightsbridge is an exclusive residential community offering a collection of four-bedroom townhouses and five- and six-bedroom villas designed to combine contemporary architecture with refined luxury living. The residences feature expansive layouts, elegant architectural detailing, and spacious living areas created to accommodate both family life and entertaining. The project places a strong emphasis on quality, comfort, and sustainability, integrating modern design principles with advanced residential technologies to create sophisticated homes that are both functional and future-oriented.

Residents benefit from a thoughtfully designed lifestyle environment that promotes comfort, wellness, and convenience. The community incorporates EV charging facilities, smart-home technologies, landscaped outdoor spaces, and environmentally conscious infrastructure designed to enhance everyday living. Sustainable features are seamlessly integrated throughout the development, supporting a modern residential experience focused on efficiency, comfort, and long-term value.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Interiors are designed with premium finishes, elegant detailing, and carefully selected materials that complement the project's luxury positioning. Kitchens are fully equipped with Miele appliances, combining functionality with contemporary design. The homes also include integrated smart-home systems, solar panels, energy-efficient LED lighting, UV-protected double glazing, solar water heating systems, insulated building envelopes, smart irrigation technology, and advanced water management solutions that enhance sustainability and everyday efficiency.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba is located south of Dubai Creek, near the part of the city where indigenous people traditionally settle. Nad Al Sheba is close to Al Quoz, Silicon Dubai Oasis, Ras Al Khor industrial area and Al Markada. Properties here include villas, apartments and serviced apartments. A rich legacy awaits in a setting that resonates with all those who know the area.

The serene greenery of Nad Al Sheba is one of the city’s most covetable locations. A mere ten minutes from Downtown Dubai, this luxurious community has easy access to the Meydan Racetrack and many other premium leisure and lifestyle experiences. The Dubai International Airport and all major highways also lie within arm’s reach of Nad Al Sheba’s enviable location.

Nad Al Sheba Gardens is strategically located to give you the utmost in a privacy-focused lifestyle while connecting you to the best of Dubai’s city life. It’s a space built around carefully curated amenities. All this and more makes Nad Al Sheba Gardens a community tailored to truly nurture your inner and outer growth for today and future generations to come.
